mass_kg.formula: m_C0 6.18217 + 0.0353 printed module cone (0.0555 m^2 x 0.5 mm x 1270) + 0.0293 XPS cone extension on the forebody (0.1011 m^2 x 0.29 kg/m^2, areal mass from the 35.5 g / 0.1224 m^2 C0 cone) + 0.012 rings - 0.0355 C0 foam cone + 0.018 wiring/connectors = +0.059 kg (rev 1: +0.100)

cg_x_m.formula: x_cg = (m0 x0 + dM_x)/m1 gives -0.0735 m before the fix (30.8 % MAC); pod group (2.497 kg) slides +0.0167 m forward to return to -0.0668 m (28 % MAC); rev 2: dM_x -35.9 g m (EST) needs a 13.8 mm slide; built with 16.7 mm (rev 1 value) = CG about 1.2 mm forward of -0.0668 m, inside the M5 3 mm tolerance

static_margin_pct.formula: SM = NP - CG = (47.63 - dNP) - 28.0; dNP = -0.27 % MAC (+0.0011 m^3 tail volume, Munk 2(k2-k1)V/(S c CLa) with k2-k1 0.9 EST) - 0.1..0.4 % MAC (prop normal force at 0.081 m more lever, N_alpha = 0.3..1.0 T/rad EST)

width_m.formula: overall width = max(span 2.40 m, across the lift discs 2 x (0.4337 + 0.2159) = 1.299 m) = 2.40 m; pod length 0.95 m (C0 0.85) is under the 1.2 m longest piece

cruise_power_W.formula: P = D V / (eta_p eta_ME), eta_p 0.6, eta_ME 0.85; dD = +0.034 N induced (W^2) + 0..0.031 N pod (Squire-Young vs Raymer, midpoint) = +0.049 N; BLI credit -0.26 W; inflow-distortion penalty 0..+12 W NOT included (upper range); rev 2: induced dD +0.020 N (W^2), pod +0.015 N, BLI credit -0.26 W

endurance_min.formula: t = (E_pack x 0.8 x 0.95 x 3600 - P_hover x 160 s)/P_cruise/60, E_pack 144.3 Wh
endurance_min.meaning: cruise minutes available after 2 min hover + 40 s transition and 20 % reserve

parts_new.detail: 3 CAD parts (Tail_Cone, Tail_Joint_Spigot, Tail_Joint_Sleeve) + 20 hardware/wire pieces (hardware_delta)

parts_removed.detail: Fuselage_Pod is modified (forebody only); W15 replaced by W15x

trl_note: TRL 3-4: all subsystems are C0 parts; the new element is a printed tail cone and a pod re-registration. The BLI effect itself is predicted at +0.07 percentage points over C0 (PSC 1.22 % vs 1.15 % of ideal disc power, EST) and is not measurable with the team's instruments (watt meter). Medium risk comes from tail-strike margin (18.5 deg without wheels), cone stiffness (f_n target >= 40 Hz, unmeasured) and the CG/pod re-registration, not from the aerodynamics.

bli.psc_scaling: PSC ~ 0.19 x phi (EST, actuator disc, 14 in prop)

rev_note: Rev 2 (2026-11-03): joint plane moved aft of the wing (x=-0.26 m). Mass-related values below re-estimated (EST); aero values (pod drag, BLI, NP) are unchanged because the outer profile is unchanged.
